chunks: Muhammad ibn Musa ibn al-Mutawakkil, may Allah be pleased with him, narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Yahya al-Attar narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab narrated to us. He said: al-Nadr ibn Shu'ayb narrated to us from Khalid al-Qalanisi from al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad from his father from his forefathers, peace be upon them.

He said: The Messenger of God, may God bless him and his family, said: When I rise to the Praiseworthy Station, I will intercede for those who have committed major sins from my Nation; so God will accept my intercession for them. By God, I will not intercede for those who harm my offspring.

key_terms.أُمَّتِي: My Nation; the Muslim community that follows the Prophet
key_terms.الْكَبَائِرِ: Major sins; grave sins such as murder, theft, and disobedience to God
key_terms.الْمَقَامَ الْمَحْمُودَ: The Praiseworthy Station; a special station promised to the Prophet on the Day of Judgment (Quran 17:79)
key_terms.تَشَفَّعْتُ: I will intercede; the act of shafa'ah (intercession) on behalf of sinners before God
key_terms.ذُرِّيَّتِي: My offspring; the Prophet's descendants, whose protection is a religious duty

ai.seo_question: Will Prophet Muhammad intercede for those who harm his offspring on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Amali of Shaykh al-Saduq, the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) declares that at the Praiseworthy Station (al-Maqam al-Mahmud, referenced in Quran 17:79) on the Day of Judgment, he will intercede for those of his Nation who committed major sins and God will accept his intercession. However, he swears an oath that he will categorically refuse to intercede for anyone who harmed his offspring. This teaching was a stern warning to early Muslim communities that hostility toward the Prophet's descendants would result in being excluded from his intercession on the Day of Judgment.
word_analysis: so He will accept my intercession

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Musa b. al-Mutawakkil (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Yahya al-`Attar narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. al-Husayn b. Abi’l Khattab narrated to us. He said: Al-Nadr b. Shu`ayb narrated to us from Khalid b. al-Qalanisi from al-Sadiq Ja`far b. Muhammad from his father from his forefathers (as).

He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said: When I rise to the Praiseworthy Station (al-maqam al-mahmud), I will intercede for those who have committed major sins from my Nation; so, Allah will accept my intercession of them. By Allah, I will not intercede for those who harm my offspring.
